proposals.evidence: Dhakal p. 56 contrasts /lo.ki.ke/ “to hide” with /ro.ki.ke/ “to stop.” Turner11083 section 3 lists the MIA *lukka- replacement, Nepali luknu and Oriya lukibā “hide,” plus Old Awadhi lokāvaï with the same o-vowel as Darai. The Darai lo- stem belongs to the hide family.
